text:
incident-bot: P1 page — streaming tail latency spike (US-west) detected. Elevated p95/p99 and intermittent SSE/WebSocket stalls. Auto-incident created. Pager: on-call eng-sre.

carla-sre: Acknowledging, on my way. quick ask: which frontends/regions and customers affected? link to alert?

ben.platform: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/6489 — p95 went from ~350ms -> ~1.2s, p99 from ~2.0s -> ~9.4s over last 12m. Error spike: stalled chunks + connection heartbeats delayed. Traces show chunk gaps at the proxy layer (proxy -> runtime).

dave-support: Customer Impact: support ticket #SUP-1212 from AcmeInc complaining about repeated stalls on live chat, 3 timed-out streams in last 10m. CX on call.

eve-net: FYI we rolled a proxy tweak 18m ago: tightened `client_buffer_limit` and reduced `keepalive_timeout` from 30s -> 10s to free sockets. Could be causing aggressive corking for slow readers.

alice.k: Good lead. Symptoms look like proxy holding back flushes when client window falls below threshold. Runtime still producing tokens but client isn't receiving chunks -> perceived stalls. Can we confirm by tailing proxy logs?

ben.platform: tail from proxy (filtered):
```
2026-03-17T18:12:03Z proxy[conn-3345]: forwarded chunk size=2048 to upstream
2026-03-17T18:12:03Z proxy[conn-3345]: client_window=16 -> buffer_hold
2026-03-17T18:12:07Z proxy[conn-3345]: chunk_flush_skipped (window low)
2026-03-17T18:12:11Z proxy[conn-3345]: keepalive_check: client silent, marking slow-consumer
```

carla-sre: That matches; proxy is marking slow consumers and pausing flushes which increases tail. Plan: revert the aggressive buffer/keepalive change to restore prior behavior, enable temporary runtime force-flush on canary, and route critical customer traffic away from the affected proxy pool. Assigning tasks: Eve revert config, Alice enable runtime workaround, Ben shift routing, Dave notify customer. ETA 5m for revert, monitor 15m.

eve-net: Reverting `client_buffer_limit` and `keepalive_timeout` now on us-west pool. Rolling config revert in 60s.

incident-bot: Config revert job started by eve-net (job id: cfg-revert-6489).

alice.k: Preparing canary patch — `streaming.force_flush=true` on 2 nodes to force immediate chunk writes even if client window small. Patch command (internal API):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" 
  https://ops.redwood/api/v1/feature_flags 
  -d '{"flag":"streaming.force_flush","env":"us-west","value":true,"targets":["canary-2","canary-3"]}'
```
Applying now.

ben.platform: Routing change: moving 10% traffic off affected proxy pool to fallback pool with older proxy config. Command: `svc route-adjust streaming-usw --remove-pool=proxy-v2 --add-pool=proxy-v1 --weight=10` — applied.

dave-support: Notifying AcmeInc: "We've identified a transient proxy configuration interaction causing streaming stalls for some clients. We're rolling back the change and applying mitigations. Sorry for the interruption; will follow up when resolved."

eve-net: Revert complete. keepalive_timeout=30s and client_buffer_limit removed. Rollback propagated to 6/6 hosts.

ben.platform: Metrics update 3m after revert: p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.6s. Looking better but still above baseline. Some residual chunk gaps for very slow clients.

alice.k: Canary force_flush applied. Observed immediate reduction in chunk_gap events on those nodes. Proposing to enable `streaming.force_flush` across the us-west pool for 10m as a mitigation while we tune slow-consumer detection.

carla-sre: Agreed. Proceed with region-wide pull-through for 10m, then revert flag. Ben, do quick smoke with load simulator?

ben.platform: Running 30s synthetic stream smoke now against canary -> p99 down to ~900ms on canaries. Applying region-wide force_flush=TRUE for 10m.

incident-bot: Feature flag rollout started by alice.k (rollout id: ff-6489).

dave-support: AcmeInc confirmed: streams are flowing again, chat no longer stalls. They report improved UX.

carla-sre: Monitoring for 20m and creating follow-up action items:
- Root cause: proxy change + aggressive slow-consumer detection -> chunk corking.
- Short-term mitigation: revert config + streaming.force_flush for 10m + traffic split to fallback pool.
- Next steps: adjust slow-consumer thresholds, add canary gating for proxy buffer changes, update runbook for streaming stalls.

carla-sre: Handoff: I'll remain primary for 2hr watch. Ben and Eve remain on call for infra/config follow-up. Alice to own runtime change rollback after tuning. Dave to coordinate with affected customers for post-incident update. Creating ticket INC-648901 in PagerDuty and a postmortem ticket.

incident-bot: Alert suppressed; watch window enabled for 2h.

carla-sre: Closing live mitigation thread — moving to post-incident channel for writeup. If anything regresses, re-ping #incidents. :thumbsup:
